intro: ZCiberNews's authentication-bypass tag archive collects 20 articles published between 13 April 2026 and 22 September 2026. Coverage spans five critical-severity CVEs: CVE-2026-20127, CVE-2026-20182, and CVE-2026-20223, each rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2019-25763 and CVE-2026-41940 at CVSS 9.8. The severity mix across the archive comprises 10 critical, 7 high, and 3 medium vulnerabilities. Affected sectors include technology, financial services, government, healthcare, and software development, with impact reported globally.
